build_observation_stacker: build an ObservationStacker instance with a given observation spec and stack size for agent-side stacking
create_stacking_actor_core: create a wrapped ActorCore that performs observation stacking using wrap_actor_core with a specified stack size
stack_reverb_observations: stack observations in a Reverb replay sample using stack_reverb_observation before batching
get_adjusted_env_spec: get an adjusted environment spec where observation shapes account for stacking with get_adjusted_environment_spec
tile_nested_arrays: tile nested arrays along a specified axis using tile_nested_array for repeating observations
